messages:
sam: Heads-up — hit a correctness edge while testing hot-prefix sharing during eviction handoff. Repro steps below.

sam: steps: 1) tenant A warms prefix P on node1; 2) eviction triggers; 3) handoff starts but prefetch races with demote -> read-after-write observed.

anya: ugh. do you have logs? any unique request ids?

sam: pasted snippet:
```
[evict] 03:12:45 tenant=A prefix=P demote:start token=0xabc
[prefetch] 03:12:45 tenant=A prefix=P prefetch:read token=0x0
[prefetch] 03:12:45 got stale data
```

luke: looks like token mismatch. We currently use per-node sequence tokens but handoff doesn't bump prefix epoch until full residency transfer completes.

maya: so prefetch can read the old KV slab if it races. proposed quick fix: bump epoch at handoff start and let readers check epoch >= handoff_epoch. cheap and safe?

jitendra: that'll solve staleness but we need to avoid thundering on warm replays. maybe allow readers to spec 'allow_stale_if_less_than_ms' param.

sam: also worried about eviction credits — if we bump epoch early we may lengthen residency and hurt fairness.

anya: alternative: make prefetch idempotent and validate by CASing against prefix-version. i.e., prefetch gets version v, then attach version to responses. on apply, if version != current, discard.

luke: agreed. maybe combine: bump epoch early + prefetch returns version token, and apply validates. safe and low latency for happy path.

opsbot: Note: created ticket INF-4123 to track. Assignee: @jitendra. Priority: P2 :spiral_note_pad:

jitendra: I'll prototype version-tagging today. If this works, we can avoid expensive global locks.

sam: thanks — would also like a short smoke that simulates heavy concurrent demotes/prefetch under eviction to assert no R/W anomalies.

maya: I'll add a perf test to the canary harness.

sam: closing loop — can we also add metric 'prefetch.version_mismatch' so we can monitor in prod?

luke: yes. add a counter + sample of request ids when mismatch > 0.

sam: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup:
